eq:local_sensitivities.correspondence: Actual final affine head derivative is assemble of both zero-shift partial rows, exactly the two coordinate sensitivities for either head.
eq:local_sensitivities.expected_type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (net : Network n m) (hw : net.Nonnegative) (x : PairVec n) (rp rn : Row m)
 (hp : Monotone rp) (hn : Monotone rn) (bp bn : ℝ) (head : Bool)
 (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => if head then (net.affineHeads rp rn bp bn y).1 else (net.affineHeads rp rn bp bn y).2) x),
 HasFDerivAt (fun y => if head then (net.affineHeads rp rn bp bn y).1 else (net.affineHeads rp rn bp bn y).2)
 (assemble ((net.originalTrace (x.1-x.2)).run (fun _ => 0) (affineReadoutSeed rp rn 0 head))) x
eq:local_sensitivities.scope: Differentiability at the actual pair input; split weights/readout rows nonnegative. The source strict gate condition ensures this premise.

eq:masked_path_product.correspondence: The actual affineLogit HasFDerivAt is the signed readout row composed with originalTrace.originalJac; that definition is the exact ordered product of active signed layer maps.
eq:masked_path_product.expected_type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (net : Network n m) (hw : net.Nonnegative) (x : Vec n) (rp rn : Row m)
 (hp : Monotone rp) (hn : Monotone rn) (bp bn : ℝ)
 (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (net.affineHeads rp rn bp bn (balancedLift n y)).1) x)
 (hh : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (net.affineHeads rp rn bp bn (balancedLift n y)).2) x)
 (α : ℕ → ℝ) (β : ℝ),
 HasFDerivAt (net.affineLogit rp rn bp bn) ((rp-rn).comp (net.originalTrace x).originalJac) x ∧
 ((net.originalTrace x).run α (affineReadoutSeed rp rn β true)).1-((net.originalTrace x).run α (affineReadoutSeed rp rn β false)).1 = (rp-rn).comp (net.originalTrace x).originalJac ∧
 ((net.originalTrace x).run α (affineReadoutSeed rp rn β true)).2-((net.originalTrace x).run α (affineReadoutSeed rp rn β false)).2 = -((rp-rn).comp (net.originalTrace x).originalJac)
eq:masked_path_product.scope: At differentiability of both actual balanced lifted heads; in particular on source strict cells. Final output is ungated and biased.

eq:w_abs.correspondence: The result uses the literal coefficientRow(abs w) composed with net.absoluteMap; absoluteMap unfolds to the ordered composition of entrywise absolute hidden matrices.
eq:w_abs.expected_type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (net : Network n m) (hc : net.Canonical) (x : Vec n) (w : Vec m) (head : Bool),
 ((net.originalTrace x).run (fun _ => 0) (affineReadoutSeed (coefficientRow (fun i => max (w i) 0)) (coefficientRow (fun i => max (-w i) 0)) 0 head)).1 +
 ((net.originalTrace x).run (fun _ => 0) (affineReadoutSeed (coefficientRow (fun i => max (w i) 0)) (coefficientRow (fun i => max (-w i) 0)) 0 head)).2 =
 (coefficientRow (fun i => |w i|)).comp net.absoluteMap
eq:w_abs.scope: Definition/model correspondence for the complete affine readout absolute path product; this is not the signed Jacobian.
